name: Glass with circuitry
note: Send it with the Glass render (internals on) at 85% fill, square, four images per send: about 3 in 4 come back right. Not the yellow render or the silhouette: with those the model rearranges the cubes. For an icon whose cubes close around empty space (search's ring), turn the camera to about -30°. The lab adds the keep-every-cube line, the cube layout and the empty-space line.
